svg.title: Starlight Tracer · 100 smooth path shapes
svg.desc: A ten by ten shape reference sheet with twenty-five waves of at most five cycles, twenty-five spirals of one to five turns with varied oval proportions, twenty arcs, fifteen open ovals, and fifteen smooth squiggles. Every path is a single continuous line made from smooth cubic curves.
svg.text: 100 unique continuous curves · waves capped at five cycles · oval spirals capped at five turns
